name: Ray Marching Particle Grid Traversal
aliases: Hybrid Ray Marching Particle Grid Traversal
definition: A hybrid ray marching technique that traverses a voxel grid to find particle hits, using a low-resolution grid for culling and a high-resolution grid for precise hit testing.
summary: Ray Marching Particle Grid Traversal is a hybrid technique using low-resolution grids for coarse culling and high-resolution grids for precise hit testing to efficiently skip empty space.
